subject: general
question: Itmad-ud-daula tomb is situated in which of the following cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Itmad-ud-Daula tomb, also known as the "Baby Taj," is a Mughal mausoleum located in Agra, India.
 
• The tomb was commissioned by Nur Jahan, the wife of Jahangir, for her father Mirza Ghiyas Beg, who was given the title of Itmad-ud-Daula (Pillar of the State).
 
• Construction of the tomb started in 1622 and was completed in 1628.
 
• The structure is considered a precursor to the Taj Mahal as it was the first Mughal structure to be built entirely of marble and feature extensive use of pietra dura inlay work.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mughal Architecture:**

 
 
• Mughal architecture is a distinct style that combines elements of Islamic, Persian, Turkish, and Indian architecture.
 
• Notable features include large bulbous domes, slender minarets at the corners, large halls, massive vaulted gateways, and delicate ornamentation.
 
 
 
• **Pietra Dura:**
 
 
• Pietra dura is an Italian term for the technique of using cut and fitted, highly polished colored stones to create images.
 
• This technique was extensively used in Mughal architecture, especially in structures like the Taj Mahal and Itmad-ud-Daula's tomb.
 
 
 
• **Nūr Jahān:**
 
 
• Nūr Jahān, originally named Mehr-un-Nissa, was the twentieth and most beloved wife of Mughal Emperor Jahangir.
 
• She was an influential empress who held significant power in the Mughal court and was known for her administrative skills, architectural patronage, and contributions to Persian culture in India.
 
 
 
• **Agra:**
 
 
• Agra is a city on the banks of the river Yamuna in the northern state of Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• It is famously known for the Taj Mahal, one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, and is a major tourist destination.
